mapper.insert: INSERT INTO manga_generation_callback_inbox (provider, event_id, provider_job_id, payload_sha256, status, next_attempt_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{provider}, #{event.eventId}, #{event.providerJobId}, #{event.payloadSha256}, 'PENDING', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actor}, #{actor}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE event_id = event_id
mapper.select: SELECT payload_sha256 FROM manga_generation_callback_inbox WHERE provider = #{provider} AND event_id = #{eventId}
mapper.update: UPDATE manga_generation_callback_inbox SET next_attempt_at = #{nextAttemptAt}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{actor} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND next_attempt_at <= #{now}
UPDATE manga_generation_callback_inbox SET status = #{status}, updated_by = #{actor}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
